title: Doc Severinsen gets The Tonight Show job
summary: Terry and Severinsen talk about the racial reason; they laughed about it.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Doc Severinson got “The Tonight Show” job. You’d known him . . .
. . . ever since he first got involved in the business, yeah.
I know you would have – for example, you knew him well enough to have him sub for you on some other engagements, like with Gerry Mulligan and people of that sort.
Yeah, and many times we used to do that.
How did he – how did you feel, and how he feel, when he got it and you didn’t? Or was it an issue between you two?
There was no issue between us, because we were both well aware of the situation, the racial situation. That’s the way it was, and there wasn’t a whole heck of a lot that you could do about it.
Oh yeah. Of course we talked about it. Yeah.

There wasn’t much – what could he say? All we could do is laugh about it. You either make fun out of it and frolic and forget it, keep steppin’, or you get angry and get sick and not even be able to do what little bit you can do.
